caption:
Stop using the green scrubber on your nonstick pans.

Regular scouring pads look tough but they bite into a coated pan's surface a tiny bit every wash. Those scratches add up quietly, and a pan that used to release food easily starts sticking and looking dull months before it should.

This sponge is designed to scrub stuck-on food without scratching the surface underneath, so it works on pans, counters, and bathroom fixtures alike. It's rated 4.8 stars from over sixty thousand reviews, and it comes as a six pack.

That means a fresh sponge at every sink without re-ordering constantly, and pans and surfaces that stay looking newer longer. It's about six dollars for the whole pack.
